areas.name: Sign-in & GitHub access
areas.tagline: Landing page, sign-in and GitHub App access
areas.summary: Visitors see a landing page with a clickable sample of the app, sign in with GitHub, then choose which accounts and repositories DiffKit may read by installing its GitHub App.
areas.how: /login starts Better Auth's GitHub OAuth flow, which stores the user and an OAuth token in D1. /setup then runs the GitHub App's own authorization and saves a second, refreshable token.
